Stock and inventory

Items with reference, unit, location and supplier; dated stock movements (in, out or sale, loss, customer or supplier return, adjustment) from which stock is computed. Reorder alerts and a list to order by supplier, stock value at weighted average cost or last purchase price, theoretical margin, slow-moving items, and cycle or full stock counts whose differences become adjustments. CSV export. A stock management tool, not accounting software.
